title: Design System: AI News Tutor (placeholder name)

source.direction: Follow the Voice — Companion (Score Follower × Show Notes), seed 1030dbaf, decision D8

accent-ink.contrast: small-text link/on tone; deepened so ≥4.5:1 on ground and plane

headline.purpose: The article title in the drawer (.drawer-title).

title.purpose: The user's question as a ruled heading (.q); the Impact heading at 18px; 18px ≤880px.

body.purpose: Answer paragraphs, lists and the Impact passage (.ai-para, .ai-list, .impact-text), max 66ch; 16px ≤880px.

body-sm.purpose: Lede, quick questions, orb caption, drawer summary; source rows / takeaways / drawer questions at 14.5px.

label.purpose: Control text: actions, rail names, KB title, drawer block titles. Never uppercase.

meta.purpose: Dates, counts, tags, the grounding note, source numbers (tabular-nums).

fontLoading.method: Google Fonts CSS2 API (next/font/google 14.2 lacks the family)

shadows.name: lift
shadows.value: 0 18px 40px -18px color-mix(in oklab, #194D49 28%, transparent), 0 2px 10px -4px color-mix(in oklab, #194D49 14%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: The article drawer only. The single drop shadow in the system.

shadows.name: inset-hairline
shadows.purpose: Pressed rail button; a 1px stroke drawn with box-shadow, not a lift.

shadows.name: orb-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The orb's :focus-visible ring (everything else uses outline 2px aqua, offset 2px).

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: The authored easing: orb drift, drawer and KB slides, mark rotation.

motion.name: orb-drift
motion.purpose: The orb moving between poses; transform only, compositor-safe.

motion.name: orb-pose
motion.purpose: Core, bloom and ring changes between the 4 poses.

motion.name: orb-breathe
motion.purpose: Idle breathing (4s while speaking, 2.4s big-breathe while listening).

motion.name: orb-shimmer
motion.purpose: The conic soft-light shimmer turning in the core.

motion.name: orb-ripple
motion.purpose: The two sage rings while listening / speaking.

motion.name: playhead-step
motion.purpose: Sentence highlight and the tick colour; colour only, no reflow.

motion.name: panel-slide
motion.purpose: Drawer slide, KB collapse (desktop grid) and KB overlay (mobile).

motion.name: control-hover
motion.value: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease

motion.name: liveness
motion.value: blink 1.2s (thinking bars), caret 1s step-end, wv .8s ease-in-out (sound wave), spin .9s linear, score-shimmer 1.4s

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) gates every transition and animation
motion.purpose: Under reduced motion the 4 orb poses are static and every position change is an instant swap.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: ≤880px: one column, rail as a 48px top strip, KB overlay, full-width drawer, orb 120/60 with 2 homes, track 24px; the desktop-guard test holds layouts above it.

components.name: Rail button
components.description: 40px glyph button on the icon rail; name appears beside it on hover/focus; aria-pressed draws an inset hairline.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 8px; background: var(--ground, #EEEFCF); border-right: 1px solid var(--hair-2, #D6D9BC); font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-btn { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-rail-btn:hover, .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { background: var(--plane, #F6F6E9); color: var(--ink, #194D49); outline: none; } .ds-rail-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--ink, #194D49); background: var(--plane, #F6F6E9); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair, #C3CBB4); } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--aqua-400, #52A88D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-name { position: absolute; left: calc(100% + 10px); top: 50%; translate: 0 -50%; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #194D49); background: var(--plane, #F6F6E9); border: 1px solid var(--hair-2, #D6D9BC); border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .15s ease; } .ds-rail-btn:hover .ds-rail-name, .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible .ds-rail-name { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Action button
components.description: Copy / Read aloud / Like under an answer: 13px/500 text on nothing; hover → plane; on → lime wash + link teal.
components.css: .ds-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-act { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-act:hover { color: var(--ink, #194D49); background: var(--plane, #F6F6E9); } .ds-act:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--aqua-400, #52A88D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-act-on { color: var(--accent-ink, #24675C); background: var(--wash, rgba(192,226,176,.48)); } .ds-act:disabled { color: var(--ink-4, #8FA394); cursor: default; background: transparent; } .ds-wave { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 14px; } .ds-wave i { display: block; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--aqua-400, #52A88D); } .ds-wave i:nth-child(1) { height: 8px; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(2) { height: 14px; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(3) { height: 6px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-wave i { animation: ds-wv .8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: -.2s; } .ds-wave i:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: -.4s; } } @keyframes ds-wv { 0%, 100% { height: 3px; } 50% { height: 14px; } }

components.description: The text fallback: one ruled line, transparent textarea, plain send glyph; the rule darkens to ink on focus.

What did Anthropic ship for small businesses?

Anthropic's workshops with 1,000+ small business owners found the physical economy is the most eager adopter. The two real blockers were data security concerns and lack of hands-on training.[2] A Claude SMB Trainer Program is rolling out to address that.

components.css: .ds-drawer { width: 400px; max-width: 100%; background: var(--plane, #F6F6E9); color: var(--ink, #194D49); border-left: 1px solid var(--hair-2, #D6D9BC); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(25,77,73,.28), 0 2px 10px -4px rgba(25,77,73,.14); padding: 20px 28px 48px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 26px; font-family: 'Google Sans Flex', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-drawer-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-drawer-date { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); } .ds-drawer-close { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-drawer-close:hover { background: var(--ground, #EEEFCF); color: var(--ink, #194D49); } .ds-drawer-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--aqua-400, #52A88D); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-drawer-title { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.012em; margin: -8px 0 0; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-dblock { border-top: 1px solid var(--hair, #C3CBB4); padding-top: 14px; } .ds-dblock-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-score-tldr { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0 0 12px; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-score-takeaways { list-style: disc; margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-score-takeaways li::marker { color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); } .ds-drawer-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 6px; margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #3E655F); } .ds-tag + .ds-tag::before { content: "· "; }

narrative.overview:
The tutor is a companion that reads to you, and the page is the score it follows. One luminous object, the orb, is the agent: it waits centre stage on the welcome, leaves the reading column when the first answer begins, drifts to its home at the foot, and can be dragged anywhere on the plane. Everything else is text set in one face on one light ground, ruled by hairlines. Beside every answer runs a sentence track in the margin: a hairline rule with a chapter tick per sentence, a peach playhead that walks it while the voice reads, and sage ticks where the read measures settle. That track is the proof that the voice and the text are one document.

The surface is quiet by count, not by volume. There are no bubbles, no avatars per turn, no composer bar owning the foot, no card stacks, no frosted glass, no blur on surfaces, no grey. The palette (teal → aqua → sage → lime → glow → peach) exists in full in exactly one place, soft-focus inside the orb; the rest of the page borrows single stops for meaning only: peach for the playhead, sage for what has been read, aqua for liveness and focus. Density is a reading column: 700px max, 17px/1.6 body, 44px between turns.

Confirmed rejections: the chat-app arrangement (bubbles, per-turn avatars, a foot-owning composer bar, a floating mic widget); frosted glass and backdrop blur; blue-tinted or hard shadows; card stacks; 4-hue category colours; uppercase labels and monospace.
keyCharacteristics: One family (Google Sans Flex, optical sizing on), one ground, one ink; every secondary tone is mixed from ink and ground in OKLAB.
Hairlines rule everything: rail, KB rows, quick questions, source list, drawer blocks, the composer, the sentence track.
The orb is the only circle, the only object with the full gradient, the only object with the sparkle, and the only thing that moves on its own.
Flat surfaces; the single shadow is the teal-tinted lift under the article drawer.
Small radii (6px, 10px); the rest of the geometry is straight rules.
Motion is one gated grammar: orb drift 400ms ease-out-quart on transform only, playhead step 200ms by colour, drawer and KB 250ms; reduced motion leaves 4 still orb poses.

rules.name: The One Object Rule
rules.body: The full teal → aqua → sage → lime → glow → peach gradient appears on exactly one object: the orb. No background, button, border or text may carry it, in part or in whole.

rules.name: The Borrowed Stop Rule
rules.body: Outside the orb a palette stop is used only to mean something: peach = the playhead, sage = read, aqua = live/focus. A stop never decorates.

rules.name: The No-Grey Rule
rules.body: Every secondary tone is color-mix(in oklab, ink, ground). There is no grey, no #000, and (except the orb's speaking sparkle) no pure white anywhere.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Google Sans Flex is the only family. No serif, no mono, no icon font; a second face is a defect.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 for reading, 500 for controls and headings. 600 exists only for inline strong inside an answer.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, tracked or eyebrow labels anywhere. A smaller size in the same face and one ink step lighter is the whole meta grammar.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: The drawer is the only surface with a drop shadow. Any other box-shadow is either a 1px inset stroke or a focus ring; a new lift is a defect.

rules.name: The Teal-Tint Rule
rules.body: Where a shadow or scrim exists it is mixed from teal-900, never black, never blue.

dos: Do set every surface on the ground (#EEEFCF) or the plane (ground 58% → white) and separate with 1px hairlines mixed from ink; hair-2 (11%) structural, hair (20%) emphatic.
Do keep the full gradient, the sparkle at its warm core, and every circle inside the orb; borrow single stops elsewhere only for meaning (peach playhead, sage read, aqua live/focus).
Do use Google Sans Flex at 400 for reading and 500 for controls, with negative tracking that grows with size (-0.002em → -0.015em), and keep meta in the same face at 12–13px in ink-2.
Do keep body ink at ≥4.5:1: ink for text, ink-2 for secondary text, accent-ink for small links and "on" states; ink-3 and ink-4 only for ghosts, disabled and decoration.

Do gate every transition and animation behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, move the orb on transform only (400ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1)), step the playhead by colour in 200ms, and slide the drawer and KB in 250ms.
Do draw a missing state in place (ghost rows, skeleton blocks, the dashed Impact passage, the hero placeholder mark) rather than leaving a blank.
Do round controls at 6px and containers at 10px; leave rows, lists, the composer and the drawer square.
donts: Don't add a chat-app arrangement: no bubbles, no per-turn avatar, no composer bar owning the foot, no floating mic widget — the user's question is a ruled heading and the composer is one ruled line.
Don't use grey, black, blue-tinted shadows, frosted glass or backdrop blur anywhere; the scrim and the drawer lift are teal-900 at low alpha.
Don't add a second shadow, a card, a filled primary button, a pill or a bordered box; the drawer lift is the only lift.
Don't put the gradient on backgrounds, text, borders or buttons, and don't draw another circle: the orb is the only object with either.
Don't set anything uppercase, tracked-out, in a second family or in monospace; don't add kickers or eyebrow labels.
Don't re-render the answer to highlight it; toggle classes on the stable [data-s] spans and move follow-scroll only on sentence change.
Don't reintroduce category colours or a 4-hue tag system; tags are bare text joined by " · ".
